Class Signup

java.lang.Object
com.cab302.vic.model.Signup
public class Signup extends Object
A volunteer's place on an event, and whether they turned up.

A signup is created when a volunteer joins an event and removed if they withdraw. After the event, the coordinator marks it as attended, which is what allows the volunteer to log hours for that event.
